provenance.commits_between_dispatched_and_head: 104b300 fix(perf+server): review remediation — night-march gate, identity-cache lock, sweep/timestamp LOWs
provenance.resolution: The p8-perf worktree HEAD moved one commit past the dispatched 8cf2bc1: 104b300 'fix(perf+server): review remediation — night-march gate, identity-cache lock, sweep/timestamp LOWs'. That commit changed solweig_gpu/utci_process.py (+29/-7, night-step shadow-march skip), which is why utci_process.py does not match its 8cf2bc1 blob; the other seven executed files are byte-identical between the two commits. All scenario runs imported the clean on-disk worktree state at 104b300 (tracked files unmodified; file mtimes Sep 1 <= 20:16 predate all runs Sep 2 >= 02:25). The utci_process delta is a performance-only night-step skip of shadowingfunction_wallheight_23 (Solweig_2022a_calc's night branch zeroes shadow without reading march outputs); its behavioral equivalence on this site is proven empirically by the SANITY gate: a fresh 24-step full-tile oracle computed with the 104b300 code matches the pre-P8 baseline bitwise on every variable.
provenance.harness_caveat: Untracked 'Input_subset' present in the worktree is not part of the executed code; site/cache/baseline paths resolve to the main tree. The runner's plain 'git' invocations in other shells resolved to the main tree (cwd reset between Bash calls); all worktree queries here and throughout the run used explicit 'git -C <worktree>' or cwd=worktree subprocess calls.

Oracles: the seven scene oracles were reused from the pre-merge cache after the P8 sanity scenario recomputed the baseline oracle fresh with worktree code and proved full-tile physics bitwise-invariant (cross-check in SANITY gate); oracles are scene-fixed full-tile runs, independent of worker windowing code.

Detected by the part path and wall time; fixed and rerun (138 s recompute). One scratch part (/tmp/p5sci/parts/sanity.json) was overwritten by the void run; the committed 2026-09-01 evidence JSON is unaffected.
